answer: Give an AI agent one daily vote on timber terrace repairs only with a unique human sponsor. Each month, registrars perform a 5-minute in-person check, deduplicate biometrics in an encrypted vault and issue one key-bound credential per person. Validators deny votes for failed checks or cross-key reuse. n keys require n people and 5n person-minutes/month; human time is a recurring cost. Corrupt registrars or faulty deduplication permit aliases. Sponsors can sell access, so this limits cheap identities, not common ownership.
